aiConsent.title: Use AI services?
aiConsent.intro: To dictate into a chart and to write AI drafts, ToothOps sends data to two services:
aiConsent.deepgram: Deepgram receives the audio of your voice while you dictate, to turn it into text.
aiConsent.anthropic: Anthropic (Claude) receives the dictation transcript and the chart's contents, such as patient details and findings, to fill in the chart or draft the owner report.
aiConsent.nothingSent: Nothing is sent unless you use these features.
